subject.title: [Feature]: Detect Containerized Environments and Disable Update Suggestions

question: Should detected containers automatically disable explicit gateway auto-update settings, or should this PR preserve auto-update unless an explicit maintainer-approved container update policy says otherwise?
rationale: The PR changes an existing stored operator setting and leaves manual update actions inconsistent, so automation cannot safely choose the product policy or upgrade behavior.

options.title: Complete the container update policy
options.body: Gate or replace both the Control UI/config Update action and update.run behavior in detected containers, then document and test the chosen auto-update behavior before merge.

options.title: Accept automatic suppression
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept that detected containers ignore update availability and explicit auto-update settings, but that policy should be visible in docs and upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94279 until the manual-update and auto-update policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Complete the container update policy
recommendation.body: Gate or replace both the Control UI/config Update action and update.run behavior in detected containers, then document and test the chosen auto-update behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for the affected status/update-startup and documented update policy surfaces points to steipete.
